Train with intention

More than one way
to make progress.

Forge is made for people who want to train across disciplines. Keep your workouts, saved routines and training plans together, rather than piecing your week together from separate notes.

Choose the time and equipment you have, log what you do, and use your history to inform what comes next.

01 / PLAN

A week that fits.

Set your training days, session length, equipment and goals. Preview AI generated weeks and six-week blocks before deciding what to use.

02 / TRAIN

Keep your own rhythm.

Log sessions and keep favourite routines in My workouts, organised in folders. Make space for strength, endurance and skill work.

03 / CONNECT

Your history, with you.

Use Forge locally, or choose an account with Apple or Google to sync your training data. Apple Health integration is optional.

Know what you’re sharing.

Google sign-in provides your account identity, name and email. Cloud sync needs your agreement. Using the AI coach sends relevant training information to Anthropic. See the full details before you choose.
